hooks.command: sh -c 'r=${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}; [ -n "$r" ] && for q in "$r" "${r%/*}/current" "${r%/*}"/[0-9]*.[0-9]*.[0-9]*; do [ -f "$q/hooks/launch.sh" ] && exec sh "$q/hooks/launch.sh" claude hook-pre-tool "$r"; done; while read -r l; do :; done; case ${AGENT_GUARD_INFRA_FAILURE_MODE:-open} in closed) m=closed a=blocking ;; *) m=open a=continuing ;; esac; echo "agent-guard: CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT env not set or no hook launcher was found; $a because AGENT_GUARD_INFRA_FAILURE_MODE=$m" >&2; [ "$m" = closed ] && exit 2; exit 0'
